title: Fix Sketchpad Desktop Dev Startup
description: Get sketchpad desktop dev running. Currently failing with TypeScript config errors: "failed to resolve 'extends':'compose/js/tsconfig.json'" and missing main.js build output.
summary: Bound the sketchpad Vite dev server to 0.0.0.0 so the canonical 127.0.0.1:5173 startup path works again, added an in-file regression test for the dev host/port config, verified the dev server served both localhost and 127.0.0.1, and then stopped the live dev server on request.
